rationale: The candidate is a coherent single bent mass in all four views, so it succeeds as an object and avoids obvious collisions or fragmentation. However, as a gymnasium massing diagram it underperforms because the dominant form reads like a continuous tapered ribbon rather than one clear long-span hall with subordinate support and a legible roof/span logic. The section is highly diagonal and sculptural, but the roof expression does not convincingly signal gym span or daylight, and there is no meaningful public void, court, or entry seam on the access edge. The form also feels detached from the parcel/access reading if one is expected, because it behaves as a self-contained object instead of a ground-responsive building. In short: good silhouette continuity, weak program contract, weak ground/public response.
